name: BackInBlack Rhy

band.style_feel: straight-eight hard rock shuffle-free groove, kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4, open hi-hat; sparse and heavy
band.key: E (riff on open E-D-A, E minor pentatonic)
parts: Part A: intro riff - sparse, riff only
Part B: verse - tight, muted power chords
Part C: chorus - full band, open chords
Part D: solo - same groove, E pentatonic lead
band.tips: Sources give 91-96 BPM; 92 is the middle of that range. Play the riff 2 bars cleanly before it starts learning; leave space between hits and keep strumming steady.

whammy.tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
how: Tune your guitar to standard (E A D G B E).
whammy.tips: Standard tuning is listed for both Angus and Malcolm Young (Line 6 tone page, tab sites); I found no whammy, octave or harmony effect on the recording.

memo: AC/DC - Back in Black: rhythm. Plexi-style crunch (Marshall 1959 + SG), amp run fairly clean with natural breakup, presence low, no pedals.

name: BackInBlack Lead
memo: AC/DC - Back in Black: solo. Same Plexi crunch with a bit more gain and mids for sustain, light delay.
